article:
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Living on a boat
Fourteen-year-old Jon Atkins hasn't had a typical childhood. His parents had always intended to buy a boat and sail round the world, and when Jon was eight they did (21) .................. that. When they first told him of the plan, Jon felt sad about (22) .................. their friends, but also excited because of the adventures he would (23) ................... Since then, Jon has sailed over 8,000km and (24) .................. the love of living on a boat.
The boat has two sleeping cabins and Jon's cabin has just enough (25) .................. to sit up in. In the main cabin there's a desk where he studies every day, as he needs to continue his education. Although he doesn't have any teachers, he doesn't think his lifestyle will (26) .................. his future choices. He plans to become a ship's captain, and is certain that life on a boat is excellent preparation for this.

questions.explanation:
B. exactly
前文提到父母 “一直打算买船环游世界”，空格处需强调 “他们确实这样做了”。exactly 表示 “恰好，正是如此”，常用于 “do exactly that” 结构，强调动作与计划一致。definitely（肯定地）、certainly（当然）、absolutely（绝对地）虽表肯定，但无法体现 “与计划完全一致” 的含义。
拓展：exactly 的常见用法：“That's exactly what I thought.”（这正是我所想的。）区分 exactly 与 exactly speaking（严格来说）。

D. leaving
语境为 “Jon 对____朋友感到难过”，需表达 “离开” 之意。leaving 是 “离开（某人 / 某地）”，符合 “离开朋友” 的搭配。departing（离开）需接介词 from（depart from）；moving（移动）、remembering（记住）与语境无关。
拓展：leave 的多义性：离开（leave friends）；留下（leave a message）；使处于（leave the door open）。

A. have
搭配 “adventures” 时，常用 “have adventures” 表示 “经历冒险”。set（设置）、do（做）、make（制造）均不与 adventures 构成固定搭配。
拓展：与 adventure 搭配的动词：have /go on /experience adventures（经历冒险）；plan adventures（计划冒险）。

B. discovered
语境为 “Jon 发现了对船上生活的热爱”，强调从无到有的认知过程。discovered 表示 “发现（原本存在但未被知晓的事物）”，符合 “发现热爱” 的逻辑。expected（期待）、imagined（想象）、believed（相信）均不符合 “通过经历获得认知” 的语境。
拓展：discover 与 invent 的区别：discover 指发现自然存在的事物（如 discover a planet）；invent 指发明创造新事物（如 invent a machine）。

C. space
修饰 “足够的____坐起来”，指物理空间。space 表示 “空间（不可数）”，侧重可占用的立体空间，符合 “船舱内坐立的空间”。area（面积）、size（尺寸）、place（具体地点）均不用于描述 “可活动的空间”。
拓展：space 的用法：物理空间（room and space）；太空（in space）；抽象空间（space for creativity）。

C. limit
语境为 “生活方式不会____未来的选择”，需表达 “限制” 之意。limit 表示 “限制，约束”，符合 “不限制选择” 的语义。contain（包含）、fix（固定）、control（控制）均与 “选择范围” 无关。
拓展：limit 的搭配：limit sth. to...（把… 限制在…）；set a limit（设定界限）；without limit（无限制地）。
